detector.box_source: one normalized cxcywh box per query

splits.test_policy: Test evaluation and comparison are unrestricted by project decision; every tried configuration must remain disclosed.

features: minimum Jaccard distance to a higher-score same-class candidate
gilg_original.target: COCO-style one-to-one true-positive label at IoU=0.50

formal_controls.implementation: loaded read-only from the formal optimized source
formal_controls.asset_binding: capture checkpoint, QCCR artifact, UMR metadata, and UMR weight SHA-256 are checked before replay

iou_regression_rescore.head: LayerNorm(256) followed by one 5-output linear layer over frozen final decoder features
iou_regression_rescore.target: maximum same-class non-crowd GT IoU for each query-class candidate
